# Contributing

Thanks for helping. A few simple rules keep the project easy to work on.

- **Open an issue first** for anything bigger than a small fix, so we agree on the direction before you spend time on it.
- **Test your change** on a real Hyprland session before you open a pull request, and say in the description what you tested. A change must not break what already works.
- **Commit messages** are `module: change`, for example `dock: fix the pinned icon order`. Put the most important change in the title and the rest in the description.
- **Follow the style around you.** No trailing whitespace, one space around operators, and match the naming and comment density of the file you are editing. `.editorconfig` and `.clang-format` describe the basics.
- **Keep it honest.** Describe what the change does and its side effects, and mention anything that changes existing behaviour. Do not add documentation for features that do not exist.
- **Look and feel changes are opt-in.** New visual options should be off by default and switchable from Nexus.

This project is a fork of [caelestia-dots/shell](https://github.com/caelestia-dots/shell). Fixes that also apply to upstream are welcome there too.
